mechanism: trend continuation after price reclaims a causally anchored volume-weighted reference, with trend structure and anti-chase gating
payer_or_constraint: participants forced to reprice inventory after a directional swing while late entrants face adverse chase risk
implementation_lessons: anchor must be determined only from bars available at signal time
reclaim is a transition event rather than price merely being above/below AVWAP
EMA structure is a regime proxy, not a second alpha claim
no adverse averaging; structural stop and cost budget are policy-owned

sources.identifier: Moskowitz Ooi Pedersen, Time Series Momentum, Journal of Financial Economics 104(2)
sources.use: directional persistence mechanism; not AVWAP parameter authority
realistic cost authority must be injected at evaluation time

falsification: reject the architecture if AVWAP reclaim does not outperform matched time/direction controls after frozen realistic costs or if anchor perturbation shows fragility
